defs.d: A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.
To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.
defs.ex: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.

defs.d: To contain, as parts of a whole; to comprehend.
defs.ex: Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?

defs.d: A pigmented filament of keratin which grows from a follicle on the skin of humans and other mammals.
The collection or mass of such growths growing from the skin of humans and animals, and forming a covering for a part of the head or for any part or the whole body.
defs.ex: In the western world, women usually have long hair while men usually have short hair.

defs.d: To remove the hair from.
To grow hair (where there was a bald spot).
A large medical facility, usually in a building with multiple floors, where seriously ill or injured patients are given extensive medical and/or surgical treatment.
A building founded for the long-term care of its residents, such as an almshouse. The residents may have no physical ailments, but simply need financial support.
Hospitable.
A telecommunication device (originally mechanical, and now electronic) used for two-way talking with another person (now often shortened to phone).
The game of Chinese whispers.
To (attempt to) contact someone using the telephone.
To convey (a message) by telephoning.
A commodity; see realty.
(grammar) One of the three genders that the common gender can be separated into in the Scandinavian languages.
True, genuine, not merely nominal or apparent.
Genuine, not artificial, counterfeit, or fake.
defs.ex: This is real leather.

defs.d: Really, very.
defs.ex: When I told him the truth, he got real mad.

defs.d: To work on a farm, especially in the growing and harvesting of crops.
To devote (land) to farming.
To cleanse; clean out; put in order; empty; empty out
defs.ex: Farm out the stable and pigsty.

defs.d: The business of cultivating land, raising stocks etc.
A farming operation; a farm, or instance of farming on a piece of land.
The body of binding rules and regulations, customs and standards established in a community by its legislative and judicial authorities.
defs.ex: entrapment is against the law

defs.d: A binding regulation or custom established in a community in this way.
defs.ex: A new law forbids driving on that road.

defs.d: To work as a lawyer; to practice law.
To prosecute or sue (someone), to litigate.
Newly made, formed or evolved; having no precedent; of recent origin; new.
Original, especially in an interesting way; new and striking; not of the typical or ordinary type.
Fuss, ado.
defs.ex: There was a bit of bother at the hairdresser's when they couldn't find my appointment in the book.

defs.d: Trouble, inconvenience.
defs.ex: Yes, I can do that for you - it's no bother.

defs.d: To annoy, to disturb, to irritate.
defs.ex: Would it bother you if I smoked?

defs.d: To feel care or anxiety; to make or take trouble; to be troublesome.
defs.ex: Why do I even bother to try?

defs.d: A mild expression of annoyance.
(Cause of) discomfort.
Serious danger.
A physical, chemical, infective agent aggressing an organism.
Aggression toward an organism resulting in a response in an attempt to restore previous conditions.
To apply force to (a body or structure) causing strain.
To apply emotional pressure to (a person or animal).
(manner) Firmly, vigorously, with strength or exertion.
(manner) Harshly, severely; in a hard manner.
defs.ex: I can't really deal hardly with people.

defs.d: Not really.
defs.ex: I think the Beatles are a really overrated band. ― Hardly!

defs.d: To sadden or displease (someone) by underperforming, or by not delivering something promised or hoped for.
defs.ex: His lack of respect disappointed her.

defs.d: To deprive (someone of something expected or hoped for).
Defeated of expectations or hope; experiencing disappointment; let down.
defs.ex: After all his anticipation, the trip left him deeply disappointed.

defs.d: Expressing or indicating disappointment.
defs.ex: a disappointed tone / face / silence

defs.d: The thin, horny plate at the ends of fingers and toes on humans and some other animals.
defs.ex: When I'm nervous I bite my nails.

defs.d: The basal thickened portion of the anterior wings of certain hemiptera.
A primary election; a preliminary election to select a political candidate of a political party.
The first year of grade school.

To challenge (an incumbent sitting politician) for their political party's endorsement to run for re-election, through running a challenger campaign in a primary election, especially one that is more ideologically extreme.
To take part in a primary election.
First or earliest in a group or series.
defs.ex: Children attend primary school, and teenagers attend secondary school.

defs.d: Main; principal; chief; placed ahead of others.
defs.ex: Preferred stock has primary claim on dividends, ahead of common stock.

defs.d: An individual or organization that creates goods and services.
One who produces an artistic production like a CD, a theater production, a film, a TV program and so on.
Without fail.
defs.ex: slowly but surely

defs.d: Certainly, undoubtedly.
defs.ex: Surely, you must be joking.

defs.d: One who enters into, or offers for, any service of his/her own free will, especially when done without pay.

One who enters into military service voluntarily, but who, when in service, is subject to discipline and regulations like other soldiers; -- opposed to conscript; specifically, a voluntary member of the organized militia of a country as distinguished from the standing army.
To enlist oneself as a volunteer.
To do or offer to do something voluntarily.
defs.ex: to volunteer for doing the dishes

defs.d: (interrogative) When ever: emphatic form of when.
defs.ex: Whenever will I find time to finish that jigsaw?

defs.d: At any time.
defs.ex: Feel free to visit whenever.

defs.d: At any time that.
defs.ex: Visit whenever you want to.

defs.d: At the (single) time that, no matter when.
defs.ex: Tomorrow I'll get up whenever the sun rises.

defs.d: An amount obtained by the addition of smaller amounts.
defs.ex: A total of £145 was raised by the bring-and-buy stall.

defs.d: Sum.
defs.ex: The total of 4, 5 and 6 is 15.

defs.d: To add up; to calculate the sum of.
defs.ex: When we totalled the takings, we always got a different figure.

defs.d: To equal a total of; to amount to.
defs.ex: That totals seven times so far.

defs.d: Entire; relating to the whole of something.
defs.ex: The total book is rubbish from start to finish.  The total number of votes cast is 3,270.

defs.d: (used as an intensifier) Complete; absolute.
defs.ex: He is a total failure.

defs.d: To admit the knowledge of; to recognize as a fact or truth; to declare one's belief in
defs.ex: to acknowledge the being of a god

defs.d: To own or recognize in a particular quality, character or relationship; to admit the claims or authority of; to give recognition to.
The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up; research, especially patient or thorough inquiry or examination
defs.ex: Despite thorough investigation, the perpetrator of the attacks remains unknown.

defs.d: A person’s condition, position or standing relative to that of others.
defs.ex: Superstition is highly correlated with economic status.

defs.d: Prestige or high standing.
An informal gathering of musicians to play music, especially improvised jazz or a similar genre.

A period devoted to a particular activity, e.g. the annual or semiannual periods of a legislative body (that together comprise the legislative term) whose individual meetings are also called sessions.
defs.ex: "Are we having a recording session?" / "Yes. We've even got some session musicians to provide some brass."

defs.d: A meeting of a council, court, school, or legislative body to conduct its business.
defs.ex: This court is now in session.

defs.d: To hold or participate in a jam session with other musicians.
